facts.text: Deborah visited a place that held a lot of memories for her and sat on a bench where she used to chat with someone.

evidence.quote: Been thinking about a few big moments lately - went to a place that held a lot of memories for me. Sat on a bench where we used to chat and it brought back a lot of emotions.

facts.text: Deborah brought flowers to the place that held a lot of memories for her.
Deborah felt nostalgia and longing at the place that held a lot of memories for her, but also felt grateful for the memories.

evidence.quote: I felt nostalgia and longing, but also grateful for the memories.

facts.text: Deborah's mother loved flowers and they always made her happy.

evidence.quote: my mom really loved flowers. They always made her so happy.
